Haa-Meem
yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib-e-aqtidaar , baray ilm ka malik hai ,
jo gunah ko moaaf kernay wala , tauba qubool kernay wala , sakht saza denay wala , bari taqat ka malik hai . uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi . ussi ki taraf sabb ko loat ker jana hai .
Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray wohi log peda kertay hain jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai . lehaza inn logon  ka shehron mein dandanatay phirna tumhen dhokay mein naa daalay .

inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur unn kay baad boht say girohon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha , aur her qoam ney apney payghumber kay baaray mein yeh irada kiya tha kay unhen girftaar kerlay , aur unhon ney batil ka sahara ley ker jhagray kiye thay takay uss kay zariye haq ko mita den . nateeja yeh huwa kay mein ney unn ko pakar mein ley liya . abb ( dekh lo kay ) meri saza kissi ( sakht ) thi ?
aur issi tarah jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay baaray mein tumharay perwerdigar ki yeh baat bhi pakki hochuki hai kay woh dozakhi log hain .

woh ( farishtay ) jo arsh ko uthaye huye hain , aur jo uss kay gird mojood hain , woh sabb apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay rehtay hain , aur uss per emaan rakhtay hain , aur jo log emaan ley ayen hain unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay hain ( kay ) :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! teri rehmat aur ilm her cheez per hawi hai , iss liye jinn logon  ney tauba kerli hai , aur teray raastay per chal parray hain , unn ki bakhshish farma dey , aur unhen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley .

aur aey perwerdigar ! unhen hamesha rehney wali unn jannaton mein dakhil farma jiss ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai . neez unn kay maa baap aur biwi bacchon mein say jo naik hon , unhen bhi . yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
aur unn ko her tarah ki buraiyon say mehfooz rakh .   aur uss din jissay tu ney buraiyon say mehfooz kerliya , uss per tu ney bara reham farmaya . aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay :  ( aaj ) tumhen jitni beyzari apney aap say ho rahi hai ,   uss say ziyada beyzari Allah ko uss waqt hoti thi jab tumhen emaan ki dawat di jati thi , aur tum inkar kertay thay .

woh kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! tu ney hamen do martaba moat di ,   aur do martaba zindagi di , abb hum apney gunahon ka aetraaf kertay hain , to kiya ( humaray dozakh say ) nikalney ka koi raasta hai-?

. ( jawab diya jaye ga kay : )  tumhari yeh halat iss liye hai kay jab Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar kertay thay , aur agar uss kay sath kissi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan letay thay . abb to faisla Allah hi ka hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi , jiss ki zaat boht bari hai .
wohi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata , aur tumharay liye aasman say rizq utaarta hai . aur naseehat to wohi maana kerta hai jo ( hidayat kay liye ) dil say rujoo ho .
lehaza ( aey logo ! ) Allah ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabeydaari khalis ussi kay liye ho , chahye kafiron ko kitna bura lagay .

woh oonchay darjon wala , arsh ka malik hai . woh apney bandon mai say jiss per chahta hai apney hukum say rooh ( yani wahi ) nazil ker deta hai takay mulaqat kay uss din say ( logon  ko ) khabrdar keray

jiss din woh sabb khul ker samney aajayen gay , Allah say unn ki koi cheez posheeda nahi hogi . ( kaha-jaye ga : )  kiss ki badshahi hai aaj-?  ( jawab aik hi hoga kay : )  sirf Allah ki jo wahid o qahaar hai .
aaj kay din her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga . aaj koi zulm nahi hoga . yaqeenan Allah boht jald hisab lenay wala hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) inn logon  ko aik aesi museebat kay din say darao jo qareeb aaney wali hai , jab logon  kay kalejay ghutt ghutt ker mun ko aajayen gay , zalimon ka naa koi dost hoga , aur naa koi aisa sirfarishi jiss ki baat maani jaye .
Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi janta hai , aur unn baaton ko bhi jinn ko seenon ney chupa rakha hai .

aur Allah bar-haq faislay kerta hai , aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko yeh pukartay hain , woh kissi cheez ka faisla nahi ker-saktay . yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .

aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein chal phir ker yeh nahi dekha kay jo log inn say pehlay thay , unn ka kaisa anjam hochuka hai . woh taqat mein bhi inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur zameen mein chorri hoi yaadgaaron kay aetbar say bhi . phir Allah ney unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur koi nahi tha jo unhen Allah say bachaye .

yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aatay thay , to yeh inkar kertay thay , iss liye Allah ney unhen pakar mein liya . yaqeenan woh bari quooat wala , saza denay mein bara sakht hai .
aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyon aur bari wazeh daleel dey ker firon , hamaan aur qaroon kay paas bheja tha ,
to unhon ney kaha kay yeh jhoota jadoogar hai .

phir jab woh logon  kay paas woh haq baat ley ker gaye jo humari taraf say aai thi   to unhon ney kaha kay :  jo log unn kay sath emaan ley aaye hain , unn kay beton ko qatal ker daalo , aur unn ki aurton ko zinda rakho .  halankay kafiron ki chaal ka anjam iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay woh maqsad tak naa phonch saken .

aur firon ney kaha :  lao mein musa ko qatal hi ker daalun , aur ussay chahiye kay apney rab ko pukar ley . mujhay darr hai kay yeh tumhara deen badal daalay ga , ya zameen mein fasad barpa kerday ga .
aur musa ney kaha :  mein ney to her uss mutakabbir say jo yoam-e-hisab per emaan nahi rakhta , uss ki panah ley li hai jo mera bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar .

aur firon kay khandan mein say aik momin shaks jo abhi tak apna emaan chupaye huye tha ,   bol utha kay :  kiya tum aik shaks ko sirf iss liye qatal ker rahey ho kay woh kehta hai mera perwerdigar Allah hai-? halankay woh tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say roshan daleelen ley ker aaya hai . aur agar woh jhoota hi ho to uss ka jhoot ussi per parray ga ,   aur agar sacha ho to jiss cheez say woh tumhen dara raha hai , uss mein say kuch to tum per aa hi parray gi . Allah kissi aesay shaks ko hidayat nahi deta jo hadd say guzar janey wala ( aur ) jhoot bolney ka aadi ho .

aey meri qoam ! aaj to tumhen aesi saltanat hasil hai kay zameen mein tumhara raj hai , lekin agar Allah ka azab hum per aagaya to kon hai jo uss kay muqablay mein humari madad keray-?  firon ney kaha :  mein to tumhen wohi raye dun ga jissay mein durust samajhta hun , aur mein tumhari jo rehnumai ker raha hun , woh bilkul theek raastay ki taraf ker raha hun .
aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! mujhay darr hai kay tum per wesa hi din naa aajaye jaisa boht say girohon per aa-chuka hai .
. ( aur tumhara haal bhi wesa naa ho ) jaisa haal nooh ( aleh-assalam ) ki qoam ka , aur aad o samood ka aur unn kay baad kay logon  ka huwa tha . aur Allah bandon per zulm kerna nahi chahta .
aur aey meri qoam ! mujhay tum per uss din ka khof hai jiss mein cheekh pukar machi hogi ,
jiss din tum peeth pher ker iss tarah bhago gay kay koi bhi tumhen Allah say bachaney wala nahi hoga , aur jissay Allah bhatka dey , ussay koi raasta dikhaney wala moyassar nahi aata .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss say pehlay yousuf ( aleh-assalam ) tumharay paas roshan daleelen ley ker aaye thay ,   tab bhi tum unn ki laee hoi baaton kay mutalliq shak mein parray rahey . phir jab woh wafaat paagaye to tum ney kaha kay unn kay baad Allah abb koi payghumber nahi bhejay ga .   issi tarah Allah unn tamam logon  ko gumrahi mein daalay rakhta hai jo hadd say guzray huye , shakki hotay hain ,

jo apney paas kissi wazeh daleel kay aaye baghair Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikala kertay hain . yeh baat Allah kay nazdeek bhi qabil-e-nafrat hai , aur unn logon  kay nazdeek bhi jo emaan ley aaye hain . issi tarah Allah her mutakabbir jabir shaks kay dil per mohar laga deta hai .
aur firon ney ( apney wazir say ) kaha kay :  aey hamaan ! meray liye aik oonchi imarat bana do , takay mein unn raaston tak phonchun

jo aasmano kay raastay hain , phir mein musa kay khuda ko jhank ker dekhun .   aur yaqeen rakho kay mein to ussay jhoota hi samajhta hun .  issi tarah firon ki badd kiradaari uss ki nazar mein khushnuma bana di gaee thi , aur ussay raastay say rok diya gaya tha .   aur firon ki koi chaal aesi nahi thi jo barbadi mein naa gaee ho .
aur jo shaks emaan ley aaya tha uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam ! meri baat maano , mein tumhen hidayat kay raastay per ley jaon ga .
aey meri qoam ! yeh dunyawi zindagi to bus thora saa maza hai , aur yaqeen jano kay aakhirat hi rehney basney ka asal ghar hai .

aur jiss shaks ney koi burai ki hogi , ussay ussi kay barabar badla diya jaye ga , aur jiss ney naik kaam kiya hoga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , jabkay woh momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay . wahan unhen bey hisab rizq diya jaye ga .
aur aey meri qoam ! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf dawat dey raha hun , aur tum mujhay aag ki taraf bula rahey ho ?

tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay Allah ka inkar kerun , aur uss kay sath aesi cheezon ko shareek maanun jinn kay baaray mein mujhay koi ilm nahi hai , aur mein tumhen uss zaat ki taraf bula raha hun jo bari sahab-e-iqtidar , boht bakhshney wali hai .

sach to yeh hai kay jinn cheezon ki taraf tum mujhay bula rahey ho , woh kisi dawat kay ehal nahi hain , naa duniya mein , naa aakhirat mein ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum sabb ko Allah ki taraf palat ker jana hai , aur yeh kay jo log hadd say guzarney walay hain , woh aag kay baasi hain .
gharz tum unqareeb meri yeh baaten yaad kero gay jo mein tum say keh raha hun , aur mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun . yaqeenan Allah saray bandon ko khoob dekhney wala hai .
nateeja yeh huwa kay unn logon  ney jo buray buray mansoobay bana rakhay thay , Allah ney uss ( mard-e-momin ) ko unn sabb say mehfooz rakha , aur firon kay logon  ko badd tareen azab ney aa ghera .
aag hai jiss kay samney unhen subha o shaam paish kiya jata hai ,   aur jiss din qayamat aajaye gi , ( uss din hukum hoga kay : )  firon kay logon  ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kerdo .

aur uss waqt ( ka dhiyan rakho ) jab yeh log dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagarr rahey hon gay , chunacheh jo ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh unn logon  say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya tum aag ka kuch hissa humaray badlay khud ley lo gay ?
woh jo baray banay huye thay , kahen gay kay :  hum sabb hi iss dozakh mein hain . Allah tamam bandon kay darmiyan faisla ker-chuka hai .
aur yeh sabb jo aag mein parray hon gay , dozakh kay nigranon say kahen gay kay :  apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din hum say azab ko halka kerday .

woh kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay payghumber khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aatay nahi rahey thay-?  dozakhi jawab den gay kay :  beyshak ( aatay to rahey thay . )  woh kahen gay :  phir to tum hi dua kero , aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjam ikarat janey kay siwa nahi hai .
yaqeen rakho kay hum apney payghumberon aur emaan laney walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad kertay hain , aur uss din bhi keren gay jab gawahi denay walay kharray hon gay ,
jiss din zalimon ko unn ki maazrat kuch bhi faeeda nahi dey gi , aur unn kay hissay mein phitkaar hogi , aur unn kay liye rehaeesh ki bad-tareen jagah .
aur hum ney musa ko hidayat ata ki , aur bani Israel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya
jo aqal walon kay liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur apney qusoor per astaghfaar kertay raho ,   aur subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho .

yaqeen jano kay jo log Allah ki aayaton kay baaray mein jhagray nikaltay hain , jabkay unn kay paas ( apney daway ki ) koi sanad nahi aai , unn kay seenon mein aur kuch nahi , balkay uss barai ka aik ghamand hai jiss tak woh kabhi phonchney walay nahi hain .   lehaza tum Allah ki panah maango . yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , sabb kuch dekhney wala hai .
yaqeeni baat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ka peda kerna insanon kay peda kernay say ziyada bara kaam hai , lekin aksar log ( itni si baat ) nahi samajhtay .
aur andha aur beenai rakhney wala dono barabar nahi hotay , aur naa woh log jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , woh aur bad-kaar barabar hain , ( lekin ) tum log boht kam dhiyan detay ho .
yaqeen rakho kay qayamat ki gharri zaroor aaney wali hai , jiss mein kissi shak ki gunjaeesh nahi hai , lekin aksar log emaan nahi latay .

aur tumharay perwerdigar ney kaha hai kay :  mujhay pukaro , mein tumhari duayen qubool kerun ga , beyshak jo log takabbur ki bana per meri ibadat say mun morrtay hain , woh zaleel ho ker jahannum mein dakhil hon gay .

Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banai , takay tum uss mein sukoon hasil kero , aur din ko dekhney wala banaya . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , her cheez ka peda kernay wala . uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir kahan say koi cheez tumhen ondha chala deti hai ?
issi tarah woh log bhi ondhay chalay thay jo ( pehlay ) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya , aur aasman ko aik gunmbad , aur tumhari soorat giri ki , aur tumhari soorton ko acha banaya , aur pakeezah cheezon mein say tumhen rizq ata kiya . woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai . gharz bari barkat wala hai Allah , saray jahano ka perwerdigar !

wohi sada zinda hai , uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . iss liye uss ko iss tarah pukaro kay tumhari tabey daari khalis ussi kay liye ho . tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mujhay iss baat say mana kerdiya gaya hai kay jab meray paas meray rab ki taraf say khuli khuli nishaniyan aa chuki hain , to phir bhi mein unn ki ibadat kerun jinhen tum Allah kay bajaye pukartay ho . aur mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tamam jahano kay perwerdigar kay aagay sar jhuka dun .

wohi hai jiss ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir jamay huye khoon say . phir woh tumhen bacchay ki shakal mein bahir lata hai , phir ( woh tumhari perwerish kerta hai ) takay tum apni bharpoor taqat ko phonch jao , aur phir boorhay hojao aur tum mein say kuch woh bhi hain jo iss say pehlay hi wafaat paajatay hain aur takay tum aik muqarrar miyaad tak phoncho , aur takay tum aqal say kaam lo .
wohi hai jo zindagi deta aur moat deta hai . aur jab woh kissi kaam ka faisla kerleta hai to uss say sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojata hai .
kiya tum ney unn logon  ko dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagray nikaltay hain-? koi kahan say unn ka rukh pher deta hai-?
yeh log woh hain jinhon ney iss kitab ko bhi jhutlaya hai , aur uss ( taleem ) ko bhi jiss ka hamil bana ker hum ney apney payghumber bhejay thay . chunacheh unhen unqareeb pata lagg jaye ga
jab unn kay galon mein toq aur zanjeeren hon gi , unhen garam paani mein ghaseeta jaye ga ,
phir aag mein jhonk diya jaye ga ,
phir unn say kaha jaye ga :  kahan hain Allah kay siwa woh ( tumharay mabood ) jinhen tum khudai mein uss ka shareek maana kertay thay-?
yeh kahen gay :  woh sabb to hum say khoye gaye , balkay hum pehlay kissi cheez ko nahi pukara kertay thay .    iss tarah Allah kafiron ko badd hawaas ker deta hai .
. ( inn say yeh pehlay hi keh diya gaya hoga kay : )  yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay tum zameen mein nahaq baat per itraya kertay thay , aur iss liye kay tum akarr dikhatay thay .
jao , jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay takabbur kernay walon ka thikana boht hi bura hai .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo . yaqeen rakho kay Allah ka wada sacha hai . abb hum inn ( kafiron ko ) jiss ( azab ) say dara rahey hain , chahye uss ka kuch hissa hum tumhen bhi ( tumhari zindagi mein ) dikhla den , ya tumhen duniya say utha len , bahar-soorat inn ko humaray paas hi wapis laya jaye ga .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber bhejay hain . unn mein say kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen bata diye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney tumhen nahi bataye . aur kissi payghumber ko yeh ikhtiyar nahi hai kay woh Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi moajza ley aaye .   phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sachai ka faisla hojaye ga , aur jo log batil ki perwi ker rahey hain , woh uss moaqa per sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .
Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye maweshi peda kiye , takay unn mein say kuch per tum sawari kero , aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jinhen tum khatay ho .

aur tumharay liye unn mein boht say faeeday hain , aur unn ka maqsad yeh bhi hai kay tumharay dilon mein ( kahen janey ki ) jo hajat ho uss tak phonch sako . aur tumhen unn janweron per aur kashtiyon per utha kerlay jaya jata hai .
aur Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikha raha hai , phir tum Allah ki kinn kinn nishaniyon ka inkar kero gay ?

bhala kiya unhon ney zameen mein chal phir ker nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa ? woh inn say tadaad mein ziyada thay , aur taqat mein bhi inn say barhay huye thay , aur unn yaadgaaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chorr ker gaye hain . phir bhi jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kuch kaam nahi aaya .

chunacheh jab unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli daleelen ley ker aaye , tab bhi woh apney uss ilm per hi naaz kertay rahey jo unn kay paas tha , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , ussi ney unn ko aa ghera .

phir jab unhon ney humara azab aankhon say dekh liya to uss waqt kaha kay :  hum khudaye wahid per emaan ley aaye , aur unn sabb ka hum ney inkar kerdiya jinn ko hum Allah kay sath shareek thehraya kertay thay .

lekin jab humara azab unhon ney dekh liya tha to uss kay baad unn ka emaan lana unhen faeeda nahi phoncha sakta tha . khabar daar raho kay Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo uss kay bandon mein pehlay say chala aata hai . aur uss moaqa per kafiron ney sakht nuqsan uthaya .
